info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_QR Payment Request Retrieval API
info.description: The QR Payment Request Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific QR payment requests. By providing a unique identifier, consumers can retrieve the current status and associated details of a payment request, facilitating transparency and monitoring of financial transactions. This API is commonly used by merchants and payment processors who need to track and verify payment entries instantly. It plays a crucial role in payment reconciliation and operational efficiency in digital transactions.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific QR payment request using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows users to obtain all relevant information regarding the payment request, including status and metadata.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the QR payment request details. Ensure that the necessary identifiers and parameters are accurately specified to get the relevant data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning payment request details.

GetQrPaymentRequestByIdRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the QR payment request operations.

qrPaymentRequestId.description: The unique identifier for the QR payment request.

merchantId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant who created the payment request.

outletId.description: The unique identifier for the outlet where the payment request is generated.

terminalId.description: The unique identifier for the terminal processing the transaction.

mode.description: The mode of the payment (e.g., test, production).

standard.description: The standard that the payment follows.

amount.description: The amount to be paid in the QR payment request.

merchantOrderId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant’s order associated with the payment.

description.description: A description of the payment request.

tipOptions.description: Options for tipping associated with the payment request.

qrPayload.description: The payload data encoded in the QR code.

qrImageUrl.description: The URL for the generated QR code image.

status.description: Current status of the payment request (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

singleUse.description: Indicates whether the QR payment request can be used only once.

paidAmount.description: The amount that has been paid in the QR payment request.

paymentId.description: The unique identifier for the payment transaction.

expiresAt.description: The expiration date and time of the payment request.

audit.description: Audit information related to the creation and updates of the payment request.

metadata.description: Additional metadata information related to the payment request.

GetQrPaymentRequestByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful retrieval of QR payment requests, containing details such as the payment request ID, amounts, and merchant details.

value.description: The numerical value of the amount.

Amount.description: Represents a currency amount with its value.

mode.description: The mode of tipping (e.g., optional, mandatory).

fixedAmounts.description: A list of fixed amount tip options.

percentages.description: A list of percentage tip options.

items.description: A percentage value as a string.

TipOptions.description: Options related to tipping for the payment request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the payment request was created.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the payment request.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment request was last updated.

updatedBy.description: The identifier of the user who last updated the payment request.

version.description: The version number of the payment request.

Audit.description: Audit information for tracking changes made to the payment request.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the transaction is processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata information associated with the payment request.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that utilizes a Bearer token, specifically JSON Web Tokens (JWT), for authorization of API requests. This method provides a secure means to access protected resources.
